description:
Calculate grow-room HVAC cooling, dehumidification, airflow, and reheat requirements using the Greenzone Engineering calculation engine. ChatGPT can collect room, lighting, environmental, cooling-coil, and system inputs, submit them to the calculator, and explain the returned results.  

The calculator supports Imperial/US and metric units, integrated and decoupled system configurations, rule-of-thumb comparisons, and analysis using selected actual airflow rates. Results are preliminary engineering estimates and should be reviewed by a qualified professional before final equipment selection or system design.
